column1: Design a hinted-handoff mechanism for a Dynamo-style store and explain how it must interact with read-repair to avoid resurrecting deleted keys.
Explain how a Raft implementation's log compaction (snapshotting) interacts with lagging followers that need entries already discarded from the log.
Design a distributed outbox pattern for reliably publishing events transactionally alongside a database write, without a distributed transaction.
Implement a bounded-staleness read protocol for a follower replica and explain how it uses a high-water-mark timestamp to reject overly stale reads.
Design a service discovery system that handles rolling deployments without routing requests to instances mid-shutdown.
Explain how a quorum-based system chooses read/write quorum sizes to trade off latency against consistency, and design a tunable-consistency API for it.
Design a backfill strategy for repopulating a newly added read replica without blocking live writes to the primary.
Design a distributed semaphore service that correctly releases permits when a client holding one crashes without heartbeating.
Design a multi-region-aware load balancer that shifts traffic during a regional outage while respecting per-region capacity limits and avoiding cascading overload.
Design a saga-based orchestration system for a multi-service checkout flow with compensating transactions for partial failures.
Design a control plane for dynamically reconfiguring shard-to-node assignments in a sharded database with zero-downtime data movement.
Explain how a distributed rate limiter built on a CRDT-based counter trades off precision for availability compared to one requiring synchronous coordination.
Design a cross-datacenter replication topology (hub-and-spoke vs mesh) for a globally distributed cache and analyze the write-amplification trade-off.
Design a distributed job scheduler that must guarantee at-most-once execution for non-idempotent tasks despite worker crashes and network partitions.
Explain how a partitioned Kafka-style log's consumer group rebalancing protocol can cause duplicate or lost message processing during a rolling restart, and design a mitigation.
Design a two-level hierarchical consensus scheme (per-shard Raft groups coordinated by a meta-Raft group) and analyze its failure-recovery latency under a meta-group leader crash.
Prove that a given hybrid logical clock preserves the happens-before partial order while remaining within a bounded drift of physical time.
Design a formally specified membership-change protocol for a replicated state machine (joint consensus) and prove it prevents dual-leader scenarios during reconfiguration.
Design a globally linearizable distributed counter service and prove a fundamental lower bound on its cross-region write latency.
Design a Byzantine-fault-tolerant state machine replication protocol optimized for geo-distributed WAN deployment, and prove its latency bound matches the network diameter under the optimistic case.
Implement a wavelet tree over a sequence supporting rank/select/quantile queries in O(log sigma) time, and explain its space usage relative to the zero-order entropy.
Design an algorithm for finding a minimum spanning tree in a dynamic graph with edge insertions and deletions, maintaining the MST in sub-linear amortized time per update.
Implement a rolling hash-based algorithm for finding the longest common substring between two large strings and analyze its collision-probability guarantees.
Design an algorithm to compute strongly connected components using Tarjan's algorithm and prove its single-pass O(V+E) correctness via the low-link invariant.
Implement a persistent (functional) leftist heap supporting O(log n) merge, and explain why this beats a binary heap for this operation.
Design an algorithm for the stable marriage problem using Gale-Shapley and prove it always terminates with a proposer-optimal matching.
Implement an offline algorithm for the least common ancestor problem using Tarjan's union-find-based approach, and derive its near-linear time bound.
Design a rope data structure for efficient string concatenation and slicing in a text editor, and analyze its amortized edit-operation complexity.
Design a parallel algorithm for constructing a suffix array using prefix doubling, and derive its O(n log n) work and O(log^2 n) depth bounds.
Implement a wavelet matrix supporting O(1) rank queries over a large alphabet and compare its cache behavior to a wavelet tree.
Design an approximate algorithm for the k-median clustering problem with a provable constant-factor approximation ratio.
Implement a segment tree beats structure supporting chmin/chmax range updates with range sum queries in amortized O(log n) per operation.
Design an algorithm for maximum bipartite matching using the Hopcroft-Karp algorithm and prove its O(E sqrt(V)) time bound.
Design a data structure supporting dynamic connectivity queries on an undirected graph using an Euler tour tree in O(log^2 n) per update.
Design an external-memory sorting algorithm (multi-way merge sort) and derive its I/O complexity in terms of the number of block transfers.
Prove the correctness of Karger's randomized min-cut algorithm and derive the number of trials needed for high-probability success.
Design a streaming algorithm for the heavy-hitters problem using the Count-Min sketch and derive its space-error trade-off with a formal proof.
Design a parallel algorithm for the all-pairs shortest path problem that achieves near-linear work in sparse graphs using randomized techniques.
Prove tight bounds on the query complexity of the element-distinctness problem in the quantum query model, contrasting with the classical lower bound.
Design a cache-oblivious B-tree structure that achieves optimal I/O complexity without knowledge of the cache-line or block size, and prove the bound.
Design a serverless event-processing architecture for a fraud pipeline that must maintain sub-second cold-start-free latency across bursty traffic.
Design a microservices decomposition for a monolithic e-commerce inventory system that avoids distributed-transaction anti-patterns across the new service boundaries.
Design a multi-tenant data warehouse architecture with workload isolation guaranteeing no tenant's ad-hoc query can starve another tenant's scheduled reports.
Design an architecture for a push-notification system delivering to 500M devices with per-user rate limits and delivery-receipt tracking.
Design a canary-deployment traffic-shaping system that automatically rolls back based on real-time error-rate and latency regression detection.
Design an architecture for a geofencing service that evaluates millions of concurrent location updates against dynamic polygon boundaries in near real time.
Design an API versioning and backward-compatibility strategy for a public API used by thousands of third-party integrations.
Design a log-aggregation pipeline architecture that can absorb a 50x traffic spike during an incident without dropping or delaying alerting-critical log lines.
Design the architecture of a recommendation-serving system that blends a candidate-generation stage with a real-time re-ranking model under a 20ms latency budget.
Design an architecture for a distributed rate-limited web crawler that respects per-domain politeness policies across thousands of worker nodes.
Design a multi-region active-active architecture for a social-media feed service that reconciles conflicting concurrent edits to the same post.
Design an architecture for a real-time anomaly-detection system monitoring millions of IoT sensor streams with adaptive per-device baselining.
Design a data-pipeline architecture for training-serving skew prevention, ensuring feature computation is identical between offline training and online inference.
Design an architecture for a multi-cloud disaster-recovery strategy for a stateful service that avoids vendor-specific consistency-model assumptions.
Design a large-scale A/B testing platform architecture that avoids interaction effects between overlapping simultaneous experiments.
Design the full architecture of a global inventory-reservation system for a flash-sale event handling 1M concurrent reservation attempts on a fixed-stock item without overselling.
Design the architecture of a real-time collaborative whiteboard supporting thousands of concurrent editors per board with conflict-free merge semantics at scale.
Design a planet-scale secrets-management system with sub-second key rotation propagation and provable guarantees against partial-rotation inconsistency.
Design a pipeline-parallel training architecture (GPipe-style) for a model that doesn't fit on a single accelerator, and derive the pipeline-bubble overhead as a function of micro-batch count.
Explain how gradient checkpointing trades recomputation for memory savings during backpropagation, and derive the optimal checkpoint placement for a fixed memory budget.
Design a data-parallel training setup using ring all-reduce and derive its bandwidth-optimal communication cost independent of the number of workers.
Explain how gradient compression via top-k sparsification affects convergence, and design an error-feedback mechanism to correct for the resulting bias.
Design a mixed-precision training pipeline with dynamic loss scaling and explain how it prevents gradient underflow without sacrificing numerical stability.
Explain how tensor parallelism splits a transformer's attention and MLP layers across devices, and derive the resulting all-reduce communication volume per layer.
Design a parameter-server architecture for asynchronous distributed training and analyze how staleness bounds affect convergence guarantees.
Explain how ZeRO (Zero Redundancy Optimizer) partitions optimizer state, gradients, and parameters across data-parallel workers, and derive its memory savings versus standard data parallelism.

Design a 3D-parallelism training configuration (data, tensor, pipeline) for a trillion-parameter model, and derive how to choose the parallelism degrees given a fixed GPU count and interconnect topology.
Explain how activation recomputation interacts with pipeline parallelism's microbatching to bound peak memory, and derive the resulting throughput trade-off.
Design a fault-tolerant distributed training system that can resume from a mid-epoch worker failure without restarting from the last full checkpoint.
Explain how gradient compression using quantization (e.g. 1-bit SGD) introduces bias, and design a correction scheme that preserves convergence guarantees.
Design an elastic distributed training system that can add or remove workers mid-training without restarting the job, and analyze the learning-rate rescaling required.
Explain how sequence parallelism reduces activation memory for long-context transformer training beyond what tensor parallelism alone achieves.
Prove a convergence bound for asynchronous SGD under bounded staleness and derive how the bound degrades as the number of stale workers grows.
Design a communication-avoiding distributed training algorithm that overlaps gradient all-reduce with backward-pass computation, and derive the theoretical speedup limit.
Derive the optimal micro-batch size and pipeline depth that minimizes end-to-end training time for a given model size, device count, and interconnect bandwidth, accounting for pipeline bubbles.
Prove a tight lower bound on the communication complexity of distributed gradient aggregation across p workers for a d-dimensional model, and connect it to the ring all-reduce's optimality.

Design a decentralized (all-reduce-free) distributed training algorithm using gossip-based gradient averaging and prove its convergence rate matches centralized SGD up to a network-topology-dependent factor.
Prove that a finitely presented group has decidable word problem if and only if it satisfies a specific small-cancellation condition, and outline the algorithmic construction.
Prove the classification theorem for finitely generated abelian groups and explain its use in computing the Smith normal form of an integer matrix.
Prove that the fundamental group of a topological space is a homotopy invariant, and use it to show the torus and sphere are not homeomorphic.
Prove the existence of a Groebner basis for any polynomial ideal using Dickson's lemma, and explain Buchberger's algorithm's termination argument.
Prove the Cayley-Hamilton theorem via the adjugate matrix identity and explain its use in computing matrix minimal polynomials efficiently.
Prove that the category of finite-dimensional vector spaces is equivalent to the category of matrices, and explain the functorial correspondence.
Prove Zorn's lemma is equivalent to the axiom of choice via the well-ordering theorem, and outline the proof strategy.
Prove Hensel's lemma for lifting a simple root of a polynomial modulo p to a root modulo p^k, and explain its role in p-adic root-finding algorithms.
Prove the classification of finite simple groups' role in bounding the automorphism group of a strongly regular graph, at a high level.
Prove the Atiyah-Singer index theorem's statement for the special case of the Gauss-Bonnet theorem, connecting curvature integration to the Euler characteristic.
Prove that the Galois group of a general quintic polynomial is not solvable, and connect this to the impossibility of a radical formula for its roots.
Prove the Riemann-Roch theorem for algebraic curves and explain its role in bounding the dimension of a linear system of divisors.
Formalize and prove the correctness of a red-black tree's insertion invariant preservation in a dependently typed proof assistant, describing the invariant-carrying type.
Formalize the type-safety proof of a simply typed lambda calculus in Coq using the progress and preservation lemmas, and describe the induction principle used.
Formalize a proof of Cantor-Schroder-Bernstein theorem in Lean using classical logic, and explain where the axiom of choice is or isn't required.
Prove the Nash embedding theorem's statement (isometric embedding of Riemannian manifolds into Euclidean space) at a high level and explain the role of the Nash-Moser implicit function theorem.
Formalize and machine-check a proof of the irrationality of e in Isabelle/HOL, describing the continued-fraction-based proof strategy encoded.
Prove the Poincare conjecture's reduction to Ricci flow with surgery at a conceptual level, explaining why singularity formation required Perelman's surgery technique.
Formalize a proof of Godel's incompleteness theorem inside Lean's type theory itself, and explain the self-reference encoding challenge this presents for the proof assistant's own consistency.
Prove the Weil conjectures' statement relating point counts over finite fields to the topology of a complex variety, and outline Deligne's use of etale cohomology.
Design an authenticated key exchange protocol resistant to a compromised long-term key still preserving forward secrecy for prior sessions (as in the Signal protocol's X3DH).
Explain how a length-extension attack against SHA-256-based MACs works, and design a construction that avoids it without switching hash families.
Design a secure enclave (SGX-style) attestation protocol and identify what trust assumptions it makes about the enclave manufacturer.
Explain how a downgrade attack against TLS cipher-suite negotiation can force a weak cipher, and design a signed-transcript mitigation.
Design an anonymous credential scheme allowing a user to prove group membership without revealing which member they are, and describe the underlying primitive.
Explain how a birthday attack against a hash function's collision resistance determines the practical security level given its output size.
Design a secure firmware-update mechanism with rollback protection that prevents downgrade to a known-vulnerable signed version.
Explain how format-preserving encryption is constructed from a Feistel network over a non-binary domain, and analyze its security margin at small domain sizes.
Design a privacy-preserving contact-discovery protocol using private set intersection, and analyze its communication complexity versus a naive approach.
Explain how the Logjam attack exploited export-grade Diffie-Hellman parameters, and design a parameter-selection policy that prevents similar precomputation attacks.
Design a ratcheting encryption scheme (Double Ratchet-style) providing both forward secrecy and post-compromise security, and explain the role of the symmetric-key and DH ratchets.
Explain how a Meltdown/Spectre-style speculative-execution attack leaks memory across a privilege boundary, and design a mitigation using speculation barriers.
Design an attribute-based encryption scheme enforcing fine-grained access policies over ciphertexts, and explain the trust model for the policy-issuing authority.
Explain how a supply-chain attack against a package manager's dependency-resolution algorithm can inject malicious transitive dependencies, and design a reproducible-build defense.
Design a secure aggregation protocol for federated learning that prevents the server from seeing individual client updates while still computing their sum.
Prove the security of a commitment scheme's binding and hiding properties under the discrete-log assumption.
Design a post-quantum key-encapsulation mechanism based on the module-LWE problem and explain its ciphertext-expansion trade-off versus classical ECDH.
Explain the mathematical construction of a pairing-based BLS signature scheme and prove its aggregate-signature verification correctness.
Design a formally verified constant-time cryptographic implementation methodology and specify what side-channel classes it provably eliminates versus what remain out of scope.
Prove the security of the Signal protocol's continuous key ratchet against an adaptive adversary in the generalized universal composability framework.
Compile a WebAssembly module's linear memory model and explain how it enforces spatial memory safety despite lacking a traditional MMU-based page table.
Design a WASM runtime's trampoline mechanism for calling imported host functions, and explain the overhead versus a native function call.
Explain how WebAssembly's structured control flow (blocks, loops, branches) enables single-pass validation, contrasting it with arbitrary-goto bytecode formats.
Design a garbage-collected language's compilation target for WebAssembly using the GC proposal's typed references, and explain the tracing implications.
Explain how a WASI capability-based sandboxing model restricts a compiled module's filesystem access compared to a native process.
Design a JIT tiering strategy (interpreter to baseline to optimizing compiler) for a WASM engine and explain the on-stack-replacement mechanism for hot-loop upgrades.
Explain how WebAssembly's SIMD proposal maps portable 128-bit vector operations onto heterogeneous host ISAs (SSE vs NEON), and identify semantics that can't be preserved exactly.
Design a control-flow-integrity mechanism for a WASM engine's indirect calls, and explain how function-signature checking prevents type-confusion exploits.
Design a component-model-based linking strategy for composing multiple WASM modules with shared-nothing interfaces, and analyze the marshaling overhead at the boundary.
Explain how a WASM engine implements exception handling using the exception-handling proposal's tag-based mechanism, and compare it to native zero-cost unwinding.
Design a deterministic WASM execution environment for a blockchain smart-contract platform and identify sources of non-determinism (floating point, memory growth) that must be eliminated.
Explain how ahead-of-time compiling WASM to native code handles the module's dynamic memory-growth semantics without sacrificing bounds-check elimination optimizations.
Design a multi-threading model for WebAssembly using shared memory and atomics, and explain the memory-consistency model it must expose to guest code.
Explain how stack-switching (the WASM stack-switching proposal) enables implementing green threads or generators inside a WASM module, and what it requires from the host engine.
Design a formally specified type-soundness proof for the WebAssembly core semantics, and explain the role of the validation algorithm in the proof.
Design a WASM-based confidential-computing runtime that provides remote attestation over the compiled module's hash, and analyze its trust boundary versus native SGX enclaves.
Design a whole-program dead-code-elimination and tree-shaking pass operating on the WASM binary format post-compilation, and prove it preserves observable behavior.
Prove the type-safety and determinism guarantees of a WebAssembly-based smart-contract virtual machine under adversarial host-function inputs.
Design a formally verified WASM-to-native compiler backend and specify the semantic-preservation theorem it must establish relative to the WASM reference interpreter.
Explain how a GPU's SIMT execution model causes warp divergence on a data-dependent branch, and design a branchless reformulation of a conditional kernel to avoid it.
Design a CUDA kernel for matrix multiplication using shared-memory tiling and derive the arithmetic-intensity improvement over a naive global-memory implementation.
Explain how memory coalescing affects global-memory bandwidth utilization on a GPU, and redesign a strided-access kernel to achieve coalesced access patterns.
Design a CUDA reduction kernel that avoids bank conflicts in shared memory and minimizes warp-level divergence during the tree-reduction phase.
Explain the occupancy trade-off between registers-per-thread and threads-per-block on a GPU, and derive the optimal block size for a given kernel's register usage.
Design a persistent-kernel GPU architecture for a streaming workload that avoids kernel-launch overhead for many small sequential operations.
Explain how a GPU's memory hierarchy (L1/L2 cache, shared memory, global memory) trades off latency and bandwidth, and design a tiling strategy for a convolution kernel that maximizes L2 reuse.
Design a multi-GPU NCCL-based all-reduce implementation and explain how the ring topology minimizes bandwidth usage across NVLink-connected devices.
Explain how tensor cores accelerate mixed-precision matrix multiplication, and design a kernel that correctly handles the FP32 accumulation to avoid precision loss.
Design a CUDA graph-based execution strategy to reduce kernel-launch overhead for a workload with many small dependent kernels, and analyze the capture-and-replay trade-off.
Explain how warp-level primitives (shuffle, ballot) enable register-only reductions without shared memory, and design a warp-level softmax kernel using them.
Design a GPU kernel-fusion strategy for a sequence of elementwise operations to minimize global-memory round-trips, and analyze the compute-versus-memory-bound trade-off.
Explain how a GPU scheduler's thread-block-to-SM assignment affects load balancing for an irregular workload, and design a persistent-thread-based load-balancing scheme.
Design a custom CUDA kernel for flash-attention that avoids materializing the full attention matrix in global memory, and derive its memory-complexity improvement over the naive implementation.
Design an analytical performance model (roofline model) for a GPU kernel and use it to determine whether a given kernel is compute-bound or memory-bound, deriving the arithmetic-intensity threshold.
Explain how a GPU's asynchronous copy and multi-stage software pipelining (as in Hopper's TMA) hide global-memory latency behind compute, and design a pipelined kernel using it.
Design a sparse-matrix GPU kernel format (e.g. blocked-ELL) optimized for a specific sparsity pattern, and derive its load-balancing guarantees across thread blocks.
Design a formally analyzed GPU memory-consistency model for a kernel using inter-thread-block synchronization via atomics, and prove the absence of a specific class of data races.

Derive the theoretical peak FLOP/s achievable on a specific GPU architecture's tensor cores accounting for instruction-issue and memory-bandwidth bottlenecks, and design a kernel that provably approaches this bound.
Design a mean-reversion trading strategy using an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process fit via maximum likelihood, and derive the optimal entry/exit thresholds under a transaction-cost constraint.
Design a volatility-targeting portfolio rebalancing scheme and derive how its turnover scales with the realized-volatility estimation window length.

Design an optimal execution algorithm for a large order that must minimize a combination of market impact and timing risk over a fixed horizon, and derive its closed-form trading trajectory under linear impact.
Design a credit-default-swap pricing model incorporating a hazard-rate term structure calibrated to observed CDS spreads.
Design a factor-timing strategy using macro regime indicators, and derive how estimation error in regime probabilities degrades the strategy's realized Sharpe ratio.
Design a collateral-optimization system for a derivatives portfolio subject to variation-margin calls, and derive the funding-cost minimization objective.
Design a statistical model for intraday seasonality in trading volume and use it to construct a volume-weighted execution schedule (VWAP-tracking algorithm).
Design a multi-curve interest-rate framework separating discounting and forwarding curves post-2008, and derive the basis-spread adjustment it requires relative to a single-curve model.
Design a stochastic volatility inspired (SVI) parameterization for fitting an implied-volatility smile, and derive the no-arbitrage constraints its parameters must satisfy.
Design a counterparty credit risk exposure model (potential future exposure) for a derivatives netting set, and derive how netting and collateral thresholds reduce the exposure profile.
Design an optimal hedging strategy for a variance swap under a stochastic-volatility model, and derive the residual hedging error from discrete rebalancing.
Design a regime-switching model (Markov-modulated) for asset returns and derive the filtering equations used to infer the latent regime in real time.
Design a liquidity-adjusted value-at-risk model that accounts for bid-ask spread costs under stressed-liquidation scenarios.
Design a cross-asset arbitrage detection system exploiting triangular mispricing in FX markets, and derive the no-arbitrage constraint it must check in real time.

Derive the exact solution for the optimal liquidation trajectory under the Almgren-Chriss model with both permanent and temporary market impact, and characterize how risk-aversion changes the trajectory's convexity.
Design a multi-factor stochastic volatility model with jumps (SVJ) and derive its Fourier-transform-based option-pricing formula via the characteristic function.
Design a robust portfolio optimization formulation under model uncertainty (worst-case over an ambiguity set of covariance matrices), and derive the resulting tractable convex reformulation.

Derive the exact free-boundary condition for the optimal exercise boundary of an American option under a stochastic-volatility model, and characterize its dependence on the volatility-of-volatility parameter.
Design a mean-field game formulation for optimal execution among many strategic traders competing for the same liquidity, and derive the resulting equilibrium trading-rate equations.
Design a leader-lease mechanism for a primary-backup system that safely bounds the time a demoted leader might still serve stale reads after losing its lease.
Design a bulk-loading strategy for rebuilding a distributed index from a full data snapshot without blocking concurrent incremental updates.
Implement a monotonic-stack-based algorithm for the largest rectangle in a histogram problem and prove its linear-time correctness.
Design an algorithm for computing the median of a data stream using two heaps and analyze its amortized insertion cost.
Design a rate-limited multi-tenant job queue's fair-share scheduling algorithm using a deficit round-robin approach, and derive its fairness bound.
Design a circuit-breaker library's half-open state transition logic and explain how it avoids reopening the circuit on a single probe failure.
Explain how a WASM module's memory64 proposal changes the linear-memory addressing model, and identify what existing sandboxing invariants must be re-verified.
Design a CUDA kernel launch configuration selector that picks grid and block dimensions based on a target occupancy, and explain the trade-offs versus a fixed configuration.
Design a checkpoint-restart mechanism for a long-running distributed training job that must resume deterministically across a heterogeneous mix of GPU generations.
Formalize the proof that insertion sort is a stable sorting algorithm in a proof assistant, describing the invariant used in the loop-based induction.
Explain how a GPU's L2 cache persistence hints can be used to pin frequently reused data (e.g. KV-cache) across kernel launches, and analyze the eviction-policy trade-off.
Design a distributed rolling-upgrade coordinator for a stateful cluster that enforces a minimum quorum of upgraded-compatible nodes before proceeding to the next batch.
Design a gang-scheduling policy for a multi-GPU cluster shared by many distributed training jobs, and explain how it avoids the deadlock that plain FIFO scheduling can cause.
Design a hierarchical all-reduce topology-aware collective communication scheme for a training cluster spanning multiple network fabrics (NVLink, InfiniBand, Ethernet).
Explain how a WASM engine's ahead-of-time tiering decision (interpret vs compile) affects cold-start latency for a serverless FaaS platform, and design a hybrid strategy.
Design a GPU kernel autotuning system that searches tile sizes and thread-block configurations offline, and explain how it generalizes across input-shape distributions without re-tuning per shape.
Formalize a machine-checked proof of the AVL tree's rebalancing invariant preservation in Coq, describing the height-difference invariant carried through rotations.
Design a distributed checkpointing protocol for asynchronous SGD that captures a globally consistent snapshot without pausing all workers simultaneously (Chandy-Lamport style).
Explain how a GPU's cooperative-groups API enables grid-wide synchronization within a single kernel launch, and design a kernel that uses it to implement a multi-phase reduction.
Design a formally verified WASM bytecode validator and specify what invariant it must establish to guarantee the interpreter never accesses out-of-bounds memory.
Prove a tight bound on the minimum number of communication rounds required for a pipeline-parallel schedule to achieve a target GPU-utilization ratio, given a fixed number of pipeline stages.
Design a formally specified memory-safety proof for a WASM linear-memory bounds-check-elimination optimization, and show it preserves the trap semantics of the unoptimized code.

Design a mixed data- and expert-parallel training architecture for a sparse mixture-of-experts model spanning thousands of GPUs, and derive the all-to-all communication cost as a function of expert-capacity factor.
Formalize and machine-check a full compiler-correctness proof from a simply typed source language down to WebAssembly, specifying the simulation relation between source and target semantics.

Prove a tight theoretical lower bound on GPU memory bandwidth required to train a transformer of a given size at a target tokens-per-second throughput, accounting for activation recomputation trade-offs.
Design a formally verified distributed checkpoint-consistency proof for elastic distributed training that tolerates workers joining mid-epoch with a different data shard assignment.
